summary: The board stays one self-contained HTML file with no new dependency, framework, build step or external asset — enforced structurally by a test asserting exactly one <style> and one <script> and no src/href/@import/remote url(). Overview rendering is guarded by a signature check so a poll that changes nothing does not rebuild the DOM. Derived epic relationships and reverse unblocks are O(stories x edges) over a roadmap measured in tens of items, computed per request rather than cached, which keeps decision 0017's single-source rule without a staleness surface.
non_blocking_findings: project_identity() re-reads BRIEF.md per call, including once per story_detail; negligible at roadmap scale and preferable to a cache that could disagree with the gate.
residual_risks: The task-row layout finding was raised in five consecutive rounds and rejected each time on unchanged evidence: .tasks li (index.html:406) and .tasks li summary (417) are display:flex; the grid is the one-column list container, not the row. If a future change makes a task row a grid, that rejection stops being valid.
Width proof is structural, not rendered (decision 0027): visual quality at each breakpoint is the functional check's responsibility, not CI's.
